# Animations index

<!-- GENERATED by book/tools/make-reference.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->

Every call in this book that moves, and the few that do not move yet. Each one is an interactive player: play, pause, step a quarter of a beat, or drag anywhere in the call. [Watching the animations](watching-the-animations.md) explains the controls.
